label: general-purpose AI model
definition: An AI system or model that is a general-purpose AI model.

term: Draw Up And Keep Up-To-Date Technical Documentation
label: draw up and keep up-to-date the technical documentation of the model
definition: The duty to draw up and keep up-to-date the technical documentation of the model, including its training and testing process and the results of its evaluation.
source_quote: draw up and keep up-to-date the technical documentation of the model

term: Provide Information And Documentation To Integrators
label: draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information and documentation to providers of AI systems
definition: The duty to draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information and documentation to providers of AI systems who intend to integrate the general-purpose AI model into their AI systems.
source_quote: draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information and documentation to providers of AI systems

term: Put In Place A Policy To Comply With Union Law On Copyright
label: put in place a policy to comply with Union law on copyright and related rights
definition: The duty to put in place a policy to comply with Union law on copyright and related rights, and in particular to identify and comply with, including through state-of-the-art technologies, a reservation of rights expressed pursuant to Article 4(3) of Directive (EU) 2019/790.
source_quote: put in place a policy to comply with Union law on copyright and related rights

term: Draw Up And Make Publicly Available A Summary About Training Content
label: draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary about the content used for training
definition: The duty to draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary about the content used for training of the general-purpose AI model, according to a template provided by the AI Office.
source_quote: draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary about the content used for training

term: Cooperate As Necessary With The Commission And The National Competent Authorities
label: cooperate as necessary with the Commission and the national competent authorities
definition: The duty to cooperate as necessary with the Commission and the national competent authorities in the exercise of their competences and powers pursuant to this Regulation.
source_quote: cooperate as necessary with the Commission and the national competent authorities
